τȣ́τοις (τούτοις): ȣ ligature with acute, not έ.
τȣ̃το (τοῦτο): ȣ ligature with circumflex. llama ȣ͂ is the same glyph, different codepoint; genie ῦ.

ἐπιδȣ̃ναι (ἐπιδοῦναι): ȣ ligature with circumflex. genie ῦ, llama ό wrong.
